spans.s:
Sobhari is the name of a Ṛṣi frequently mentioned in the
Rigveda.^1 The family is also referred to,^2 and a father,
Sobharī.^3
1) viii. 5, 26; 19, 2; 20, 19; 22, 2.
2) Rv. viii. 19, 32; 20, 8.
3) Rv. viii. 22, 15. Cf. viii. 103, 14;
Av. xviii. 3, 15.
Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rig-
veda, 3, 105; Oldenberg, Zeitschrift der
Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft,
42, 217.
